title: Principles of address handling for ESM procedures

entities.name: Transaction related procedure
entities.description: ESM procedures that use the procedure transaction identity as address parameter in the ESM message header. When initiated, entities include a valid PTI value and set EBI to 'no EPS bearer identity assigned'.

entities.name: EPS bearer context related procedure
entities.description: ESM procedures that use the EPS bearer identity as address parameter in the ESM message header. When network-initiated, includes valid EBI value with PTI set based on trigger condition.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: Address parameter used in transaction related procedures. Can be set to valid value or 'no procedure transaction identity assigned'.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Address parameter used in EPS bearer context related procedures. Can be set to valid value or 'no EPS bearer identity assigned'.

entities.name: Transaction related request message
entities.description: Initial message in transaction related procedures containing PTI and EBI parameters.

entities.name: Transaction related response message
entities.description: Response message in transaction related procedures containing PTI and EBI parameters.

entities.name: EPS bearer context related request
entities.description: Request message in EPS bearer context related procedures containing EBI and PTI parameters.

entities.name: EPS bearer context related response
entities.description: Response message in EPS bearer context related procedures containing EBI and PTI parameters.

entities.name: Triggered by transaction related request
entities.description: Condition where EPS bearer context procedure is triggered by receipt of transaction related request message from UE.

entities.name: Network-internal trigger
entities.description: Condition where EPS bearer context procedure is triggered network-internally.

entities.name: Triggered by user data transport via control plane
entities.description: Condition where EPS bearer context procedure is triggered by transport of user data via control plane.

relations.description: Transaction related procedures use PTI as address parameter in ESM message header.
Transaction related procedures set EBI to 'no EPS bearer identity assigned'.
EPS bearer context related procedures use EBI as address parameter in ESM message header.
EPS bearer context related procedures include PTI parameter with value based on trigger condition.
Transaction related request messages contain PTI parameter.
Transaction related request messages contain EBI parameter.
EPS bearer context related request messages contain EBI parameter.
EPS bearer context related request messages contain PTI parameter.
When triggered by transaction related request, PTI value from request is included in EPS bearer context request.
When triggered network-internally, PTI is set to 'no procedure transaction identity assigned'.
When triggered by user data transport via control plane, PTI is set to 'no procedure transaction identity assigned'.
EPS bearer context related response messages contain EBI value received from network.
EPS bearer context related response messages set PTI to 'no procedure transaction identity assigned'.
